Author: N.Tukaramji
Bench: N.Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No.5056 Of 2025
Order

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in Crime No.50 of 2025 of Suryapet TN Police Station, Suryapet District against the petitioner-accused.

entities.text: Suryapet TN Police Station, Suryapet District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner is arrayed as accused in Crime No.50 of 2025 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 420, 506 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.

3. Heard Mr.Suresh Babu Dandu, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents-State.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that though the petitioner is determined to see the process through and the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment of less than seven years, the Police concerned have not issued any notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C, as such,
the petitioner is apprehending coercive measures against him.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner is ready to cooperate with the investigation, hence prayed for necessary directions for issuance of notice as per law.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the Police concerned are ready to issue notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C and as 2 NTR,J per his instructions, the petitioner is not available for personal service and he may directed to cooperate with the investigation.
6. I have perused the materials on record.

7. Having regard to the fact that the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment below seven years and as the petitioner is ready to engage himself in the process, without going into merits of the matter, the petitioner is directed to appear before the SHO, Suryapet TN Police Station,
Suryapet District, on or before 17.04.2025, whereupon, the Investigating Officer shall issue notice on the petitioner under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C in Crime No.50 of 2025 and take up further proceedings as per the guidelines of Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.
